notes: First-party Square Online storefront for the University Ave location (address on the page: '3026 University Avenue, San Diego, California 92104', phone (619) 220-4999, matches batch address exactly). Read via browser since the Square site is a client-rendered SPA with no curl-able catalog. The order.online (DoorDash white-label) listing for this same store failed the markup test outright: dividing its 36 non-'Most Ordered' prices by 1.10 landed 27/36 exactly on round dollars or half-dollars (e.g. $16.50/1.10=$15.00, $7.15/1.10=$6.50), versus only 9/36 on nice endings unmarked -- a clean 10% online-ordering fee -- and the Square first-party prices confirm it (North Park Bowl tops out at $15.00 on Square vs $16.50 on order.online; Brown Sugar Milk Tea $6.99 top vs $7.15). order.online was NOT used as the source or as crossCheckedAgainst because its numbers are the markup, not the wall price. Sections read: Most popular (dropped, pure duplicate of items below), Energy Bowl, Best of Best: Top 7 (dropped items that duplicate Energy Bowl/Frozen Yogurt/Fruit Teas, kept the rest), Frozen Yogurt, Slushes, Fruit Teas. Catering section (Frozen yogurt party $0.00, Boba party $0-$249.75, Single Travelers Size Tea $42.40-$44.40) excluded as an adjunct/party-tray category, not the core menu. Several items show a size-based PRICE RANGE (e.g. Taro Snow $6.89-$8.50) rather than a flat number; recorded the smallest-size price and noted 'from' + the full range in description, per the build-your-own/modifier rule -- these are genuinely priced by size, not missing prices.

name: OB Sushi Sushi
notes: The restaurant's own WordPress site (obsushiya.com) confirms the address '4967 Newport Ave, San Diego, CA 92107' -- matches batch exactly -- and links to a Google Drive PDF menu, which is also headed '4967 Newport Ave / San Diego, CA 92107'. `pdftotext -layout` scrambled the multi-column NIGIRI SUSHI & SASHIMI grid and the drink lists (SAKE/WINE/BEVERAGE) -- prices shifted onto the wrong item names, e.g. ALBACORE and BLUEFIN TUNA lost their prices entirely and every subsequent row's price appeared one row early. `pdftotext -raw` preserves the PDF's content-stream order instead of visual columns and paired every name to its price with zero orphaned prices and zero orphaned names across the whole 47-page document, so it was used instead; this was cross-checked by re-running the extraction to a fresh file rather than trusting an earlier in-memory read. The nigiri/sashimi grid prints two prices per row (2pcs nigiri, 5pcs sashimi); both are recorded as separate rows tagged 'Nigiri (2pcs/order)' / 'Sashimi (5pcs/order)' in the description, only where the raw text actually gave two prices for that item -- items with only one column filled (IKURA, INARI, MASAGO, TAI, TAMAGO, UZURA) are recorded once. One row -- 'STEAMED RICE / SUSHI RICE $2.95/ $4.95' -- duplicated the exact same two values as the Miso Soup line directly above it, so its pairing could not be confirmed independently and it was left out entirely rather than guessed (the one deliberate gap in this capture). All disclaimer text, photo captions, and policy blurbs (happy-hour terms, 'served with salad/miso soup' notices) were excluded as non-menu-items; two-line wrapped item names (Hand Roll Sampler; the two 'W/Shrimp & Veggie Tempura' bento box lines) were rejoined by hand-verified rule, not guessed. Sections captured: Appetizers, Small Plates, Salads, Classic/Special/Premium/Hand Rolls, Nigiri & Sashimi (core section, present), Shooter Specials, Veggie Specials, Sushi Bento, Soups/Noodles/Rice, Entrees, Bento Boxes, Daily Specials, Bottled/Draft Beer, Sake, Wine, Beverage, Dessert -- this is the restaurant's full posted menu, not a partial. 'Extra eel sauce/spicy mayo $0.50' and 'substitute soy paper $1.00' modifier notices were excluded as add-on charges, not dishes; Ramen toppings (Egg $1.50, Roasted black garlic oil $1.00, Roasted chashu pork $3.50) were kept as their own priced a-la-carte items since the PDF lists them the same way as any other item.
